description:
Import a list of sales tax rates into WooCommerce using the provided CSV file. 

1. Ensure tax calculation is enabled in WooCommerce settings.
2. Locate the tax rate CSV file at `/home/ga/Documents/wa_tax_rates.csv`.
3. Navigate to WooCommerce > Settings > Tax > Standard rates.
4. Use the 'Import CSV' feature to bulk upload these rates.
5. Verify that 15 new tax rates (including rates for Seattle and Spokane) have been added to the Standard rates table.
